{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Miniconda
      uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        activate-environment: test-env
        auto-activate-base: true
        
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ matrix.python-version }}-
        
    - name: Install conda dependencies
      shell: bash -l {0}
      run: |
        conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda  python=${{ matrix.python-version }} cyvcf2 pytest
        
    - name: Install package
      shell: bash -l {0}
      run: |
        pip install '.'
        
    - name: Run tests
      shell: bash -l {0}
      run: |
        pytest
        python -m peddy -h
        pwd
        python -m peddy --plot data/ceph1463.peddy.vcf.gz data/ceph1463.ped
        
    - name: Install htslib and test with chr-prefixed VCF
      shell: bash -l {0}
      run: |
        conda install -c bioconda htslib
        zcat data/ceph1463.peddy.vcf.gz | awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"}{ if ($1 !~ /^#/){ $0="chr"$0 } print $0; }' | sed -e 's/contig=<ID=/contig=<ID=chr/' | bgzip -c > chr.vcf.gz
        tabix chr.vcf.gz
        python -m peddy chr.vcf.gz data/ceph1463.ped 2>e.log; tail e.log
",
  "rationale": "The workflow re-downloads dependencies on every matrix job with no dependency cache. Adding a pip dependency cache (actions/cache@v4) for ~/.cache/pip before `pip install '.'`, keyed by runner OS, matrix Python version, and the package manifest, preserves every install and test step and coverage while avoiding repeated downloads. This matches the measured P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE evidence for Python test workflows that install via pip and run pytest, and it introduces no new network access, secrets, permissions, or deployment behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
